clock.decision: right edge of the completed UTC source hour
clock.position_state: one BTC position maximum per split

controls: all-six premium-impulse side on identical clocks
all-six flow-fade side on identical clocks
deterministic random side on identical clocks
eventual_execution.funding: interior exact-time events symmetric; exact entry/exit credits dropped and debits retained; every settlement mark visited
eventual_execution.strict_mdd: global pre-entry HWM, costs, funding marks, every held five-minute favorable-then-adverse path, and virtual adverse-mark exit cost

allowed: frozen completed-hour six-alt normalized taker flow
frozen completed-hour six-alt premium-index open and close
source-only event incidence, sides, concentration, and overlap
forbidden: PnL, equity, CAGR, MDD, hit rate, or payoff

protocol.hypothesis: same-hour sign-conditional tail disagreement between aggressive alt taker flow and USD-M premium impulse marks passive absorption; a cross-sectional consensus relays into BTC in the premium direction

outcome_gate.ratio_definition: CAGR_pct / strict_MDD_pct; exact zero-MDD uses signed infinity or zero
outcome_gate.sequential_opening: train then test then eval then final; stop on first failed gate

statistical_test.cluster_value: sum of net account trade returns after costs and funding

selection.future_source_incidence: opened only after selection and used solely as a feasibility veto
selection.honest_design_history: a shared unsigned threshold prototype was source-only rejected for direction bias before this sign-conditional family was frozen
selection.rule: among 2023 source-support-passing cells maximize consensus count, then flow-tail quantile, then premium-tail quantile

signal.long_side: at least selected consensus long votes and no more than one short vote
signal.long_vote: same symbol has negative-flow magnitude in its prior negative tail and positive premium impulse in its prior positive tail
signal.short_side: at least selected consensus short votes and no more than one long vote
signal.short_vote: same symbol has positive flow in its prior positive tail and negative-premium magnitude in its prior negative tail
signal.side: premium impulse direction, opposite the absorbed taker-flow tail
signal.trigger: zero-to-directional state onset or direct polarity change

tail_calibration.history: prior 2160 completed hours with at least 360 observations per sign
tail_calibration.reason: prevent raw distribution skew from manufacturing a directional bias
